answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 5460 Country: United Kingdom Title: A 19 yr old girl would like to start memorizing the quraan. however her family are against the idea as they think she is of marriagable age and after getting married may forget the quraan due to becoming busy in her new life. Is there any special ruling in islam for females memorizing the quraan? and would it be advisable for her to start? Question: A 19 yr old girl would like to start memorizing the quraan. however her family are against the idea as they think she is of marriagable age and after getting married may forget the quraan due to becoming busy in her new life. Is there any special ruling in islam for females memorizing the quraan? and would it be advisable for her to start? Answer ID: 5460 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 661/613 =D/1429) It is a great virtue to memorize the Holy Quran by heart. It is not a good thing to stop her if she intends to memorize the Holy Quran. It is also not necessary to memorize the entire Quran. Therefore, she should intend to memorize it little by little. For example, when she manages to memorize the last five paras and starts reciting them in salah etc, then she should intend to memorize five more paras . In this way, she should memorize the holy Quran as much as she can if there is no obstacle in doing necessary house work. Thus, memorizing the whole Quran gradually will not be difficult. It will be easy for her to learn the Holy Quran by heart. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
